welcome.title: You're in the crew.
welcome.body: Four screens. Then you know where everything lives.

today.title: Today's session lives here.
today.body: Every morning you open Today. Tap the big "Start session" card and you're off. Weights are set from your 1RMs.

tabs.title: Five tabs carry the whole app.
tabs.body: Today, Train, Food, Mind and Crew sit at the bottom. Me, Reps, HRV and Science live in the menu behind your initials, top right.

formCheck.title: Technique gets a check.
formCheck.body: Tap "Form check" inside a session. Record or upload. The Motor gives a first pass; Munk signs off within 24 hours.

reps.title: You get rewarded for showing up.
reps.body: +250 Reps per completed session. +100 per week in a program. Trade them for limited drops, custom-embroidered straps, and 1:1 time with Mikael.
